title: Naples, Campania — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Naples, Campania: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Naples is a city in Campania with a population of 914,000. A vibrant Mediterranean city at the foot of Mount Vesuvius, birthplace of pizza, with a historic center, dramatic coastline, and passionate street life. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
